review_scope: advisor-meeting decision surface only; no scientific-state authority
top_defects: Time allocation overweights E1 and the cost block while underweighting the five-paper Memory/Provenance/Evolution ownership decision.
The Memory family lacks an explicit claim-ownership map for B1, Paper A, and Paper B; merge/separate wording alone is insufficient.
G1, Paper B, and 3D advisor asks each combine more than one senior decision and should be reduced to one route-changing question.

G1.question: For the current paper, should the estimand remain SHARED_CAPABILITY_CONDITIONAL, or should the paper instead target an unconditional longitudinal safety effect?

PAPER_B.question: Is the longitudinal committed-update lifecycle effect a distinct standalone causal object from Paper A’s source-fidelity effect?

3D.question: Is endpoint-sharing topology beyond relation count a scientifically durable factor of 3D instruction difficulty under the stated matched-control regime?

missing_p0_decisions: Freeze an explicit claim-ownership map: B1 = provenance-field incremental decision value; Paper A = source-faithful causal transport from source outcome to later policy; Paper B = longitudinal committed-update causal lifecycle.
Freeze a shared-premise contagion/reopen table so a failure reopens only papers whose load-bearing claim actually depends on that premise.
No other P0 meeting decision is missing once the three advisor asks are sharpened.
resource_corrections: Rename human_time to post-meeting execution human-hours so it cannot be confused with the three-hour advisor-meeting discussion allocation.
For Paper A and Paper B, display current decision cost as formalization only; the 128-run VLA blocks are future conditional envelopes and must not be visually totaled with current commitments.
Show cost_to_stop alongside cost_to_next_decision, especially for 3D and G1, to make cheap falsification versus further commitment explicit.
cut_or_merge: Replace the generic 16:10–16:35 nine-paper closure sweep with unresolved exceptions, claim ownership conflicts, and low-confidence decisions only.
Shorten the cost/dependency block to a cross-paper scarce-resource conflict check instead of rereading all nine cost rows.
Treat E2 vocabulary, G1 venue role, and Paper A/B naming as follow-through from scientific decisions rather than separate advisor agenda items.
by_17_00: Nine-paper disposition ledger: continue state | claim scope | next closure | confidence.
Memory-family ownership map for B1/Paper A/Paper B, with C1/E2 boundary unchanged unless an explicit dependency is triggered.
Shared-risk reopen table: premise -> directly affected papers -> reopen threshold.
Resource sequence preserving cheap closure, already-running compute, qualification-first, and formalize-first lanes unless a real scarce-resource collision changes order.
Every unresolved decision has one named owner and one concrete follow-up output; no generic think-more items.
do_not_spend_advisor_time_on: Prose polishing, title wording, or section order unless it changes paper identity or claim ownership.
Provider/API implementation details unless they change feasibility or scheduling order.
B1/3D live progress or interim scientific outcomes.
Exact GPU/API arithmetic already captured in the resource ledger.
Reviewer objections that do not change claim scope, next closure, ownership, or stop condition.
